∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : NormedRing.{u_1} A] [inst_1 : NormedAlgebra.{0, u_1} Real A]
  (g : Real → ContinuousLinearMap.{0, 0, u_1, u_1} (RingHom.id.{0} Real) A A)
  (D : ContinuousLinearMap.{0, 0, u_1, u_1} (RingHom.id.{0} Real) A A),
  (∀ (t : Real) (x y : A),
      Eq.{u_1 + 1} (DFunLike.coe.{u_1 + 1, u_1 + 1, u_1 + 1} (g t) (HMul.hMul.{u_1, u_1, u_1} x y))
        (HMul.hMul.{u_1, u_1, u_1} (DFunLike.coe.{u_1 + 1, u_1 + 1, u_1 + 1} (g t) x)
          (DFunLike.coe.{u_1 + 1, u_1 + 1, u_1 + 1} (g t) y))) →
    Eq.{u_1 + 1} (g 0) 1 →
      HasDerivAt.{0, u_1} g D 0 →
        ∀ (x y : A),
          Eq.{u_1 + 1} (DFunLike.coe.{u_1 + 1, u_1 + 1, u_1 + 1} D (HMul.hMul.{u_1, u_1, u_1} x y))
            (HAdd.hAdd.{u_1, u_1, u_1} (HMul.hMul.{u_1, u_1, u_1} (DFunLike.coe.{u_1 + 1, u_1 + 1, u_1 + 1} D x) y)
              (HMul.hMul.{u_1, u_1, u_1} x (DFunLike.coe.{u_1 + 1, u_1 + 1, u_1 + 1} D y)))
